
## Trial reconstruction and presentation order
```{r}
task1_order <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, A125_02) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(A125_02, sep = "\n") %>%
  dplyr::filter(A125_02 != "") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    ID,
    position = as.integer(get_field(A125_02, "position")),
    trial    = as.integer(get_field(A125_02, "trial")),
    question = get_field(A125_02, "question"),
    stimulus = get_field(A125_02, "stimulus"),
    expected = as.integer(get_field(A125_02, "expected")),
    answered = as.integer(get_field(A125_02, "answered")),
    correct  = as.integer(get_field(A125_02, "correct"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(ID, position)

task1_design <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, A124_01) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(A124_01, sep = "\n") %>%
  dplyr::filter(A124_01 != "") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    ID,
    trial       = as.integer(get_field(A124_01, "trial")),
    question    = get_field(A124_01, "question"),
    vistype     = get_field(A124_01, "vistype"),
    target      = get_field(A124_01, "target"),
    correct     = get_field(A124_01, "correct"),
    wrong       = get_field(A124_01, "wrong"),
    pair        = get_field(A124_01, "pair"),
    solution    = as.integer(get_field(A124_01, "solution")),
    opt1        = get_field(A124_01, "opt1"),
    opt2        = get_field(A124_01, "opt2")
  )

task1 <- task1_order %>%
  left_join(
    task1_design %>%
      select(ID, trial, question, vistype),
    by = c("ID", "trial", "question")
  )
```

## Accuracy analysis
```{r}
task1_model <- task1 %>%
  transmute(
    ID = factor(ID),
    trial = factor(trial),
    vistype = relevel(factor(vistype), ref = "basic"),
    position = as.integer(position),
    correct = as.integer(correct)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(correct), !is.na(position), !is.na(vistype)) %>%
  mutate(position_c = position - mean(position))
```

```{r}
vistype_table <- task1_model |>
  group_by(vistype) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_correct = sum(correct == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_incorrect = sum(correct == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_accuracy = sd(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
vistype_table
```
```{r}
vistype_table |>
  ggplot(aes(accuracy, reorder(vistype, accuracy))) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    fill = "#6BAED6"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = pmax(accuracy - sd_accuracy, 0),
      xmax = pmin(accuracy + sd_accuracy, 1)
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.14,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.17)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", accuracy)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    nudge_y = -0.20,
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    "Mean accuracy",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = vistype_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison task accuracy",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Bars show mean accuracy; error bars indicate ±1 SD."
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 22
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "italic"
    )
  )
```

```{r}

# Logistic mixed-effects model
task1_fit <- glmer(
  correct ~ vistype + position_c + (1 | ID),
  data = task1_model,
  family = binomial
)

# Estimated probabilities and 95% confidence intervals
accuracy_estimates <- emmeans(
  task1_fit,
  ~ vistype,
  type = "response"
) |>
  confint() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  transmute(
    vistype,
    accuracy = prob,
    lower_ci = asymp.LCL,
    upper_ci = asymp.UCL
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(accuracy)) |>
  mutate(
    vistype = factor(vistype, levels = rev(vistype))
  )

accuracy_estimates
```
```{r}
# Model-estimated probability of a correct response for each visualization type.
comparison_accuracy_figure <- ggplot(
  accuracy_estimates,
  aes(
    x = accuracy,
    y = vistype
  )
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower_ci,
      xmax = upper_ci
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", accuracy)),
    nudge_y = 0.36,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5),
    labels = vistype_labels
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
  limits = c(0.5, 1),
  breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)
) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison task accuracy",
    x = "Model-estimated accuracy",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Points show model-estimated probabilities; error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals."
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic")
  )

comparison_accuracy_figure

ggsave(
  project_path("figures", "comparison_accuracy_figure.png"),
  comparison_accuracy_figure,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 180
)
```

## Completion-time analysis

```{r}
task1_time <- data %>%
  select(ID, TIME005:TIME025) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ID, names_to = "time_var", values_to = "time_sec") %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    # TIME005:TIME025 correspond to experimental positions 1:21.
    position = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(time_var, "TIME")) - 4L,
    time_sec = readr::parse_double(as.character(time_sec))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    task1 %>%
      transmute(
        ID = as.character(ID),
        position,
        trial,
        vistype
      ),
    by = c("ID", "position")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_sec), !is.na(vistype))

task1_time
```

```{r}
time_table <- task1_time %>%
  remove_group_iqr_outliers(time_sec, vistype) %>%
  group_by(vistype) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_sec = median(time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sec = mean(time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sec = sd(time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

time_table |> arrange((median_sec))
```
```{r}
task1_time %>%
  remove_group_iqr_outliers(time_sec, vistype) %>%
  ggplot(aes(vistype, time_sec)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Time spent by visualization type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Time spent on page (seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
```

### Model-estimated completion time

```{r task1-time-model}
task1_time_model <- task1_time %>%
  transmute(
    ID = factor(ID),
    vistype = relevel(factor(vistype), ref = "basic"),
    position = as.integer(position),
    time_sec = as.numeric(time_sec)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ID),
    !is.na(vistype),
    !is.na(position),
    !is.na(time_sec),
    time_sec > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(position_c = position - mean(position))

task1_time_fit <- lmer(
  log(time_sec) ~ vistype + position_c + (1 | ID),
  data = task1_time_model
)

time_estimates <- emmeans(
  task1_time_fit,
  ~ vistype,
  type = "response"
) %>%
  confint() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    vistype,
    estimated_time = response,
    lower_ci = lower.CL,
    upper_ci = upper.CL
  ) %>%
  arrange(estimated_time) %>%
  mutate(vistype = factor(vistype, levels = vistype))

time_estimates
```

```{r task1-time-estimate-plot}
# Model-estimated time for each visualization type.
ggplot(
  time_estimates,
  aes(x = estimated_time, y = vistype)
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f s", estimated_time)),
    nudge_y = 0.36,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5),
    labels = vistype_labels
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f s", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison task completion time",
    x = "Model-estimated time (seconds)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Points show back-transformed model estimates;",
      "error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals."
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
```
